CETI · a data film · the Titanic, April 1912

Women and children first

A ship's manifest as a city of 2,201 boxes, one per person aboard. Pooled, the rule held: women and children lived far more often than men. Re-berthed by class, the same boxes show a third-class child lived as often as a first-class man.
